evidence_quotes.agenda: 'Any special consideration items or concerns or stress source about the moving process in general?' — asked, but only after the full intake, right before pricing.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: N/A applied — customer said 'no, none of the...' with nothing to follow up on.
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Both the estimate-variability framing and the self-prep tip landed clearly ('the better you are at consolidating things into boxes... the less time we take, the less money you end up spending'). No rate-commit line, no explicit pay-less-if-faster line, no 'does that feel fair' check.

top_strength: Thorough and unhurried with a genuinely unusual, quirky inventory (a credenza, multiple plant cabinets, disassembled furniture) for a returning customer, and warmly acknowledged the repeat business.
coaching_note: The agenda question landed as the very last item before pricing rather than up front — moving it earlier would let discovery build around whatever he says instead of being a formality before the pitch.
